title: LORD, CONVERT MY PAIN TO POWER
text: I want you to share this prayer with somebody. There's a dimension of grace that is released when you become a distributor of spiritual content. The Bible says in Proverbs 11:25, "The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that waterth shall be watered also himself." When you share anointed content, you're not just blessing someone else. You're positioning yourself for a visitation. So, right now, before we go into this word, share this with at least three people. Send it to your family group. Send it to your prayer partners. Send it to that person God has laid on your heart. As you do that, you're sewing a seed into the atmosphere. And I decree that every seed of sharing you sow this morning shall return to you sevenfold in the name of Jesus. Now, lift up your right hand toward heaven. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I thank you for this sacred moment. I thank you because you are the God who specializes in converting pain into power, shame into fame, and mourning into dancing. Lord, as we minister this morning, let every word that proceeds from this altar carry the anointing of the Holy Ghost. Let it penetrate into the depths of every heart, breaking every chain, destroying every yoke, and releasing captives in the mighty name of Jesus. Holy Spirit, you are welcome here. Take absolute control. Let your glory fall like rain in Jesus mighty name we have prayed and it is settled. Amen. The title of our ministration this morning is Lord convert my pain to power. I need you to say that with me. Say Lord convert my pain to power. One more time. Lord convert my pain to power. Glory to God. You see beloved, there is a prophetic dimension that God wants to unveil to us this morning. The scripture says in Isaiah 61:3 that God has come to appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord that he might be glorified. This is the mandate of heaven to convert to transform to transfigure every painful experience into a platform of power. Now I want you to understand something this morning. Pain is not the end of your story. It is the raw material for your testimony. The enemy may have designed that pain to destroy you. But God in his infinite wisdom has a redemptive plan to convert that very pain into supernatural power. Joseph experienced the pain of betrayal, slavery, and false accusation. But the Bible says in Genesis 50 to20, "But as for you, ye thought evil against me, but God meant it unto good to bring to pass as it is this day, to save much people alive. Every pain you have experienced has been permitted by divine providence so that it can become the catalyst for your elevation." I need somebody to hear me clearly this morning. That rejection you face, God wants to convert it into influence. That sickness that tried to take you out, God wants to convert it into a testimony that will shake nations. That financial struggle that almost broke you, God wants to convert it into a platform of abundance that will finance the gospel. The Bible says in Romans 8:28, "And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose, not some things, beloved, all things. Everything the enemy has thrown at you is about to become ammunition for your next level." Now, let me show you something powerful in the scriptures. In 2 Corinthians chapter 12, the Apostle Paul speaks about a thorn in the flesh that was given to him. The Bible says it was a messenger of Satan sent to buffet him. Three times Paul prayed that this affliction would depart from him. But watch what God said in verse 9. And he said unto me, "My grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength is made perfect in weakness." God didn't remove the pain. He converted it into a conduit for supernatural power. Paul then says,"Most gladly, therefore, will I rather glory in my infirmities that the power of Christ may rest upon me." This is the mystery. When God converts your pain to power, you begin to glory in the very thing that was designed to destroy you because you've seen the redemptive hand of God. Now, how does God convert pain into power? Number one, through the revelation of his purpose. When you understand that your pain is not random, when you understand that there is a divine agenda behind what you're going through, something shifts in your spirit. Job said in Job 23:10, "But he knoweth the way that I take. When he had tried me, I shall come forth as gold." Job understood that his pain was a purifying process. The pain you're experiencing right now is not punishment. It is preparation. God is refining you for a dimension of glory that you cannot access without passing through the fire. I prophesy to somebody right now that pain that has kept you up at night, that betrayal that shattered your heart, that loss that seemed unbearable, the Lord says, "I am about to show you what I was preparing while you were in pain." The Bible says in Psalm 30:5, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Your morning has come. The season of conversion has arrived. Every tear you've shed is about to be converted into testimonies. Every sleepless night is about to be converted into supernatural encounters. Every closed door is about to be converted into divine connections. Let me take you to the book of Acts chapter 16. Paul and Silas had been beaten, stripped, and thrown into prison. Their backs were bleeding. Their feet were fastened in stalks and they were in the innermost part of the prison. This was pain, physical pain, emotional pain, the pain of injustice. But watch what they did at midnight. They prayed and sang praises unto God. Beloved, when you can praise God in the midst of your pain, you are activating the conversion process. The Bible says as they were praising suddenly there was a great earthquake and immediately all the doors were opened and everyone's bands were loosed their pain was converted into power. Not just for them but for every prisoner in that facility. When God converts your pain to power it doesn't just affect you. It creates a shock wave that delivers entire generations. Now I want to talk about the power of prophetic perspective. You see the difference between those who remain victims of pain and those whose pain is converted to power is perspective. How you see your situation determines what you attract from heaven. The Bible says in Proverbs 23:7, "For as he thinkketh in his heart, so is he." If you see yourself as a victim, you will remain a victim. But if you see yourself as God sees you, as more than a conqueror, as the head and not the tail, as blessed coming in and blessed going out, then that pain begins to lose its grip and power begins to manifest. Let me prophesy. I see somebody watching this ministration and you've been carrying pain for years. You've been nursing wounds that have become familiar. You've built an identity around your suffering. But the Lord says this morning, I am breaking the spirit of victimhood of your life. I am changing your narrative. I am converting your identity from wounded to warrior, from broken to builder, from mer to mighty. Lift up your hands right now and receive this prophetic word. Say, "Father, I receive a new identity. I am no longer defined by my pain. I am defined by your power in Jesus' name." The second way God converts pain to power is through divine encounters. When you have an encounter with God in the midst of your pain, everything changes. Look at the life of Moses. He was a fugitive tending sheep in the wilderness, carrying the pain of failure and rejection, 40 years of obscurity. But one day, he had an encounter at the burning bush. In that encounter, God didn't just give him an assignment. God converted his pain into purpose. His staff, the symbol of his shephering. His ordinary life became the rod of God that would split seas and bring deliverance to nations. I decree by the authority of the Holy Ghost, you are about to have an encounter that will convert your pain to power. That thing that has made you feel ordinary is about to become extraordinary in the hands of God. That disappointment that left you in the wilderness is about to become your qualification for palace ministry. The Bible says in Exodus 3:12, "And he said, certainly I will be with thee, and this shall be a token unto thee that I have sent thee. When thou has brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain." God was saying to Moses, "The place of your pain will become the place of your worship." Now, let's talk about the anointing for conversion. There is an anointing that rests upon the sons and daughters of God that specializes in converting adversity into advantage. The Bible says in Joel 2:25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar and the palmer worm, my great army, which I sent among you." God is a God of restoration. But it's more than restoration is conversion. He doesn't just give back what was taken. He gives back more than enough. He converts the years of lack into abundance. The years of shame into honor, the years of struggle into supernatural ease. I want you to pray this prayer with me right now. Say, "Father, I receive the anointing for conversion. Every pain I have experienced, I present it before you as raw material. Convert my tears into treasures. Convert my losses into lessons that will establish me. Convert my scars into stars that will guide others in the name of Jesus. Let the anointing for conversion rest upon my life from this day forward. Nothing that touches me shall remain the same. Every attack of the enemy shall be converted into advancement. Every setback shall be converted into setup for breakthrough in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Let me show you something powerful about Jesus. In Luke chapter 22, Jesus told Peter, "Simon, Simon, behold, Satan had desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat, but I have prayed for thee that thy faith fail not." And when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren. Did you see that word converted? Jesus was telling Peter, you are about to go through pain. You're about to deny me three times. You are about to weep bitterly, but I've already prayed that your pain will be converted. And when it is, you will strengthen your brothers. That's a prophetic declaration over your life this morning. Your pain is not just for your benefit. It's going to strengthen generations. Now, when we talk about converting pain to power, we must understand the principle of resurrection. Pain often feels like death. The death of dreams, the death of relationships, the death of hope. But our God specializes in resurrection. The Bible says in Ezekiel 37, the prophet was taken to a valley full of dry bones. God asked him, "Can these bones leave?" And Ezekiel responded, "Oh Lord God, thou knowest." Then God told him to prophesy to the bones. As he prophesied, there was a noise, a shaking, and the bones came together. Flesh came upon them and breath entered into them and they stood up an exceeding great army. I prophesy to somebody that which died in your life is about to resurrect. That dream that died resurrection power is coming upon it. That ministry that collapsed resurrection power is coming upon it. That marriage that seen dead resurrection power is coming upon it. God is about to breathe upon the dead areas of your life and they shall live again. But this time they will not just leave. They will stand up as an exceeding great army. Your resurrection will be militant. It will be powerful. It will be undeniable. The third way God converts pain to power is through the weapon of testimony. Revelation 12:11 says, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they love not their lives unto the death." Your testimony is a weapon. When God converts your pain to power, he gives you a testimony that dismantles the works of darkness. Every time you share what God brought you through, you are releasing power into the atmosphere. You are giving hope to the hopeless. You are showing the enemy that his weapons have no power. Think about the woman with the issue of blood in Mark chapter 5. She suffered for 12 years, spent all her money on physicians and grew worse. That was pain. physical, financial, emotional, social pain. But when she encountered Jesus and received her healing, the Bible says Jesus commanded her to go and tell what great things the Lord had done for her. Her pain was converted into a testimony that has inspired millions for over 2,000 years. Your pain is about to become a bestselling testimony in the kingdom of God. Now, let me address something. Some of you have been praying for God to remove the pain, but God wants to convert it. There's a difference. When God removes pain is gone and you move on. But when God converts pain to power, that pain becomes your platform. It becomes your ministry. It becomes your message. Paul said, "I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus." He carried the scars, but they were converted into credentials of apostilhip. Your scars are about to become your credentials. I want to pray a violent prayer right now. Place your right hand on your chest. Say, "Every pain that the enemy has inflicted upon me, I command it to be converted into power right now in the name of Jesus. Every disappointment, convert it to divine appointment. Every betrayal converted to breakthrough. Every loss converted to gain. Every tear converted to triumph. I decree that from this day forward, I am a career of converted power. My life is a testimony of God's redemptive grace in Jesus name. Amen. Let me show you Hannah in 1 Samuel chapter 1. She was in pain. The pain of barness, the pain of mockery from Panina. The pain of misunderstanding even from Eli the priest. But she went to the house of God and prayed what the Bible calls a prayer of bitterness of soul. She poured out her pain before the Lord and God heard her. He didn't just give her a child. He gave her Samuel, a prophet who would change the destiny of Israel. Her pain was converted into a prophet. Your pain is pregnant with purpose. What God is about to birth out of your pain will shake systems and establish kingdoms. The Bible says in Psalm 126 to 5-6, they that sow in tears shall reap in joy. He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheavs with him. This is a prophetic principle. When you sew in tears, your sewing in the most fatile ground. Your tears are seeds. Your pain is seed. And the harvest that comes from pain seeds is always supernatural. Is always abundant. Is always undeniable. I see in the spirit realm right now that there are people watching this ministration who have been in a season of intense pain. You've been in a valley so dark you couldn't see your way forward. But the Lord is saying the valley season is over. You are about to come into a season of vindication, a season of manifestation, a season where everything I was working on in secret will become public. Your pain was the incubation period for your power. Now let's talk about the grace for endurance. Not all pain is converted immediately. Sometimes there's a process. The Bible says in James 1:2 to4, "My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into diverse temptations, knowing this, that the trying of your faith workketh patience, but let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing." God is perfecting something in you through this pain. He's preparing you for a dimension of glory that requires character, that requires resilience, that requires the kind of strength that only comes through fire. David said in Psalm 23 to 4, "Yeah, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for thou art with me. Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me." Notice he said, "Through the valley," not in the valley. You're not staying in this pain. You're passing through it. And as you pass through, God is with you. His presence is converting the atmosphere. His rod is protecting you. His staff is guiding you. You are not alone in this pain. Let me prophesy again. I see doors opening that were shut by pain. I see relationships being restored that were destroyed by pain. I see businesses rising that were better from the ashes of financial pain. I see ministries exploding that were forged in the furnace of rejection. The Lord says, "Tell my people that their pain was not wasted. Every second of suffering I was there. Every tear they shed, I collected. And now in this season, I am pouring it all back as power, as favor, as supernatural acceleration." The fourth dimension of converting pain to power is through intercession. When you begin to intercede for others who are going through what you went through, your pain becomes a bridge. It becomes a tool of deliverance. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 1:3-4, "Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforted us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God." Your pain qualifies you to minister comfort. Your pain positions you to become a deliverer. Think about how Jesus intercedes for us. The Bible says in Hebrews 4:15, "For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin." Jesus understands your pain because he experienced pain. And now he sits at the right hand of the father interceding for us with understanding. Your pain has given you the authority to intercede with power because you understand the struggle. I want you to make a commitment right now. Say, Lord, I will not waste my pain. Every pain I have experienced, I will use it to intercede for others. I will use it to comfort those who are hurting. I will use it to deliver those who are bound. My pain is converted into a ministry of deliverance in Jesus name. Now let's talk about the prophetic acceleration that comes after pain. The Bible says in Isaiah 60-22, a little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time. When God converts your pain to power, he doesn't just restore, he accelerates. What would have taken you 20 years to accomplish, you will do in two years. What would have required 10 connections, you will receive in one divine encounter. The pain you endured has positioned you for acceleration. Look at Job after his season of pain. The Bible says in Job 42:10, "And the Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before." Twice as much. That's not just restoration. That's multiplication. That's acceleration. That's supernatural increase. And notice it happened when he prayed for his friends. When he moved from receiving comfort to giving comfort. When his pain was converted into intercession. I decree upon your life. You are entering a season of double for your trouble. Everything the enemy stole you will receive back double. Every year of pain, God will compensate with two years of blessing. Every closed door will open two new doors. Your latter end shall be greater than your beginning. The Bible says in Zechariah 9:12, "Turn you to the stronghold. Ye prisoners of hope. Even today do I declare that I will render double unto thee. You are a prisoner of hope. Your hope in God will not be disappointed." Let me tell you about the midnight hour. There's something powerful about midnight in the scriptures. is the hour when God shows up is the hour of divine intervention. Abraham's seed was delivered at midnight. The death angel Passover at midnight. Paul and Silas were delivered at midnight. Midnight represents the darkest hour, the most painful moment, but is also the hour when God moves. If you are in your midnight hour right now, I have good news. God is about to show up. Your deliverance is at the door. Your conversion is imminent. Say this prayer with urgency. Lord, in my midnight hour, I call upon you. Let your presence fill this place. Let your power overshadow my pain. I declare that this is the hour of my turnaround. This is the hour of my conversion. No longer will I be defined by darkness. I will be defined by the light of your glory in Jesus name. Amen. Now, the Bible talks about beauty for ashes in Isaiah 61. Ashes represent the end of something, the death of something, the burning of something valuable. But God says he will give beauty for those ashes. Beauty is attractive. Beauty draws attention. Beauty opens doors. When God converts your pain to power, he doesn't just heal you, he makes you beautiful. He gives you a radiance, an anointing, a grace that causes people to take notice. Your story becomes so beautiful that it attracts divine opportunities. I prophesy there are people who rejected you when you were in pain. But when they see the beauty God is about to give you, they will ask what happened to you and you will have a testimony to share. Companies that rejected your application, when they see the grace upon your life, they will seek you out. Ministries that didn't recognize your calling, when they see the anointing God is releasing, they will request your presence. This is beauty for ashes. The fifth way pain is converted to power is through the oil of joy. The Bible says in Isaiah 61:3, God gives the oil of joy for morning. Oil in scripture represents anointing, represents consecration, represents power. When God pours the oil of joy upon you after a season of morning, that joy is not just an emotion, it's an anointing. It's a power source. The Bible says in Nehemiah 8:10, "The joy of the Lord is your strength. Joy becomes your weapon. Joy becomes your shield. Joy becomes your testimony." I have discovered something in my years of ministry. The most powerful people are those who have learned to rejoice in tribulation. Romans 5:3-4 says, "And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also, knowing that tribulation workketh patience, and patience experience and experience hope." When you can glory in your tribulation, when you can rejoice in your pain, you are operating at a level of spiritual maturity that the enemy cannot comprehend. And in that place, God releases uncommon grace. Let me pray for you right now. I speak to that spirit of heaviness that has been sitting on you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I command you to lift off right now. Every weight of sorrow, lift off. Every burden of pain, lift off. And I release upon you the oil of joy. I decree that from this moment, joy shall be your portion. You shall laugh again. You shall dance again. You shall celebrate again. The sound of joy shall return to your house in Jesus mighty name. Amen and amen. Now I want to talk about the garment of praise. The Bible says God gives the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. A garment is something you wear, something that covers you, something that people see when they look at you. When God converts your pain to power, he clothe you with praise. Praise becomes your identity. Praise becomes your weapon. Praise becomes your atmosphere. Everywhere you go, you carry an atmosphere of praise. And that atmosphere changes situations. Think about King Jehoshaphat in 2 Chronicles chapter 20. He was facing three armies, Moab, Ammon, and Mount Sia. The situation was hopeless, but God gave him a strategy. Put the praisers in front of the army. The Bible says, "And when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Sia, which were come against Judah, and they were smitten. When you put on the garment of praise, God fights for you. Your enemies destroy themselves, your battles become the Lord's battles. I decree every battle you are facing right now as you put on the garment of praise, God is setting ambushments against your enemies. The very thing they planned against you shall walk against them. The trap they set for you shall catch them. The weapon they fashion against you shall turn back upon them. This is the power of praise. This is the conversion of pain into power. Let me show you something about trees of righteousness. Isaiah 61:3 says that after the conversion will become trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord that he might be glorified. A tree that has deep roots can withstand any storm. The pain you've endured has forced your roots to go deep into God. You've had to dig deep for strength. You've had to reach deeper in prayer. You've had to depend on God like never before. And now those deep roots have positioned you for greatness. You cannot be moved. You cannot be shaken. You are established. The Bible says in Psalm 1:3 about the blessed man, "And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water that bringeth forth his fruit in his season. His leaf also shall not wither, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper." That's your prophetic identity. You are a tree planted by rivers of water. Your season of fruitfulness has come. Everything you thought shall prosper. Every seed you sow shall yield harvest. Every project you begin shall come to completion. This is a conversion of pain to power. Now I want to address the spirit of delay. Some of you feel like the conversion is taking too long. You've been waiting for power but the pain seems to be lingering. But the Bible says in Habachuk 2:3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tar. There is an appointed time for your conversion. It's not late. It's on time. God's timing is perfect. While you're waiting, he's working. While you're in the process, he's preparing you. While you're in the valley, he's arranging the victory. I prophesy to you, your appointed time has come. The season of waiting is over. The season of manifestation has begun. Every promise God made to you is about to come to pass. Every prophetic word spoken over your life is about to manifest. This is your Chairos moment. This is your time of visitation. Receive it by faith right now. Say, "Father, I receive my appointed time. I receive my season of conversion in Jesus name." Let me take you to the book of Acts chapter 3. There was a man who was lame from his mother's womb. 40 years of pain. Every day he was carried to the gate called beautiful to beg. But one day Peter and John passed by. And Peter said, "Silver and gold have I none, but such as I have give I thee. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk." And immediately his feet and ankle bones receive strength. The Bible says he went walking and leaping and praising God. 40 years of pain was converted in one moment to power. One moment with God can change everything. I declare this is your moment. This is your encounter. Just as that lay man received strength in his feet and ankles, you are receiving strength in every area where you were weak. Your finances are receiving strength. Your health is receiving strength. Your family is receiving strength. Your ministry is receiving strength. And you shall walk and you shall leap and you shall praise God. Your conversion has come. Now let's talk about the principle of purpose. Pain without purpose is torment. But pain with purpose is training. When you understand that your pain has a purpose, when you understand that God is using it to shape you for your destiny, the pain loses its sting. The Bible says in Romans 8:18, "For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us." Your pain is temporary, but the glory is eternal. Your pain is light, but the glory is weighty. Your pain is momentary, but the glory is everlasting. I want you to declare this. My pain has purpose. God is using it to prepare me for glory. I will not waste my pain. I will not give up in my pain. I will stand firm knowing that my labor is not in vain in the Lord. The glory that is coming is greater than the pain I've endured in Jesus name. Let me tell you about Daniel in the lion's den. That was a painful situation. Thrown into a den of hungry lions because he prayed to his God. But the Bible says God sent his angel and shut the lion's mouth. Daniel came out without even the smell of the den upon him. And what happened? King Darius made a decree that in every dominion of his kingdom, men must tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. Daniel's pain was converted into a decree that advance the kingdom of God. Your pain is about to result in decrees that will shift atmospheres. I prophesy decrees are being written in heaven concerning you. Authority figures who didn't respect your God are about to respect him because of what he does for you. systems that oppose your faith are about to make room for your God because of the testimony he's about to give you. Your pain is positioning you for influential favor. The sixth dimension of converting pain to power is through spiritual warfare. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Your pain is not just natural. There are spiritual forces behind it. But when you engage in spiritual warfare, when you take authority, when you decree and declare the word of God, you are converting that pain into power. I want you to pray with violence right now. Say, every principality assigned against my life, I bind you in the name of Jesus. Every power of darkness orchestrating pain in my life, I command you to be paralyzed right now. Every ruler of darkness that has held me bound, I break your hold by the blood of Jesus. Every spiritual wickedness in high places that has monitored my progress, your assignment is terminated. I decree that I am free. I am delivered. I am converted in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Let me show you Jesus in the garden of Gethsemane. He was in such agony that his sweat became as drops of blood. He prayed, "Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me, nevertheless, not as I will, but as thou wilt." That was pain. the pain of carrying the sins of the world, the pain of betrayal, the pain of what was to come. But Jesus endured the cross. And the Bible says in Hebrews 12:2, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is sat down at the right hand of the throne of God, his pain was converted into the power of salvation for all mankind. Your pain has saving power. Your pain will deliver someone. Now, I want to address something critical. Some of you have been holding on to your pain like an old coat. You've become so familiar with it that you don't know who you are without it. But God is saying, "It's time to let it go. It's time to release it. It's time to forgive. It's time to move forward." You cannot receive the new thing God is doing while you are clinging to the old pain. The Bible says in Isaiah 43-18:19, "Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it. I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." Say this, "I let go of my pain. I release every hurt, every offense, every disappointment. I forgive those who wounded me. I release them into the hands of God. and I open my hands to receive the new thing God is doing. I am ready for my conversion. I am ready for my power in Jesus' name. Let me pray a final prayer of conversion over you. Place your hands on your head. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I thank you for every person under the sound of my voice. I thank you because you are the God of conversion. Right now by the authority of the Holy Ghost I decree and declare that every pain in their life is being converted to power. Every tear is being converted to triumph. Every loss is being converted to gain. Every setback is being converted to setup. Every closed door is being converted to open heavens. I release upon them the oil of joy for mourning. I release upon them the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. I decree that they are trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, and you shall be glorified in their lives. From this day forward, they shall be testimonies of your redemptive grace. They shall be witnesses of your converting power. Every demonic agenda against them is terminated. Every curse is broken. Every limitation is removed. They are free to rise. They are free to shine. They are free to manifest the glory of God in Jesus mighty powerful allsufficient name. It is done. It is sealed. It is established. Amen and amen. Now I want you to begin to thank God. Begin to worship him. Begin to give him praise because your conversion has come. You are no longer a victim. You are a victor. You are no longer defeated. You are triumphant. You are no longer in pain. You are in power. Give God the highest praise. Shout unto the Lord with a voice of triumph. Your morning has come. Your joy has come. Your power has come in Jesus's mighty name. Amen.
